currentSprintFocus: 2026-08-27: Portail externe (/portal) redesigned right after Administration, three successive rounds on the same page. Round 1 (audit-first): found and fixed a critical bug where the emailed secure-download link pointed at a client route that never existed (/portal/telecharger/:token), silently defeating the entire download flow - fixed with a new PortalDownloadPage that fetches the file as a blob so expired/invalid tokens show a normalized error instead of raw JSON. Also added real per-category counts (GET /portal/documents/aggregates, same db.$count pattern as every other module), scoped rate limiting inside portal.route.ts only (10/15min token generation, 120/15min list - app-wide limiter and /api/auth left untouched, out of scope), MIME-safe preview fallback, and restructured pages/PortalPage.tsx into a pages/portal/ feature folder. Round 2: user flagged the layout as still admin-feeling against an approved mockup - widened container to max-w-350 (1400px), compact two-column hero+trust-card, search integrated into the hero band (no more isolated sticky strip), category filtering consolidated to browse cards only (redundant dropdown removed), document list rebuilt as a light public-catalogue table instead of internal DataTable styling, action wording corrected 'Télécharger' → 'Recevoir le lien' (SICOT blue, never black - the user receives an emailed link, doesn't download immediately). Round 3 (final refinement): integrated the real ANAC seal (project-owner-provided asset, packages/server/assets/anac-seal.png, never redrawn/recolored, copied to packages/client/public/) in header and hero, ISO 9001/Bureau Veritas/UKAS certification banner added to footer, category cards resized/restructured, aria-pressed selected state, distinct global/category/search empty states, pagination clamp guard, real email regex validation, HEAD pre-check before rendering PDF iframe (iframes don't reliably fire onError on a 404) so a withdrawn document shows a clear failure state instead of a blank frame. One live-edit regression caught and fixed mid-round: hero subtitle text had lost its text-white/70 opacity classes (near-invisible on the navy background) during the user's own manual tweaks - flagged rather than silently reverted, user confirmed it was accidental and asked to restore it; the header's logo-to-icon reversion in that same live edit was confirmed intentional and left as-is. Validated via tsc/eslint/build plus live curl checks (rate limit trips at request 10, publication boundary 404s unpublished IDs, HEAD 200/404 correct) - no browser automation, per the standing instruction from the Documents round. See changelog.md's 2026-08-27 Portal entry for full detail.
